<meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=Edge"/>

<script type="text/javascript">
var AnalyticsHits = [];
var CoreCommunityLoaded = false;
var CoreScriptLoaded = false;
var DashboardCancels = [];
var DashboardUpdates = [];
var MaxTimeouts = false;
var RootAnalyticsLoaded = false;
var TimeoutId;
var TimeoutCounter = 0;
var WindowFocus = window.focus;
    
var CommunityCoreConfig = {
	analytics: {
		digitalData: {
        	environment: 'dev',
            section: 'sf-ipa'	  
    	}
	},
	ighf: {
        breadcrumbs: {
            logAnalytics: true
        },
		intelNav: {
			dashboard: {
                addAllEnglish: true,
                geos: [
                    {geo: 'de_de', path: 'language=de' },
                    {geo: 'en_us', path: 'language=en_US' },
                    {geo: 'es_xl', path: 'language=es_MX' },
                    {geo: 'fr_fr', path: 'language=fr' },
                    {geo: 'id_id', path: 'language=in' },
                    {geo: 'it_it', path: 'language=it' },
                    {geo: 'ja_jp', path: 'language=ja' },
                    {geo: 'ko_kr', path: 'language=ko' },
                    {geo: 'pl_pl', path: 'language=pl' },
                    {geo: 'pt_br', path: 'language=pt_BR' },
                    {geo: 'ru_ru', path: 'language=ru' },
                    {geo: 'th_th', path: 'language=th' },
                    {geo: 'tr_tr', path: 'language=tr' },
                    {geo: 'vi_vn', path: 'language=vi' },
                    {geo: 'zh_cn', path: 'language=zh_CN' },
                    {geo: 'zh_tw', path: 'language=zh_TW' }
                ]
            },
			renderSettings: {},
			renderSettingsFooter: {}   
		}
	},
    sso: {
        redirectTest: true
    },
    validate: {
        locale: true
    }
};
    
    
function callCommunityCore() {
	CoreScriptLoaded = true;
	let urlStr = window.location.href;
    console.log('urlStr*************check'+urlStr);
	if(urlStr.match(/partner.intel.com/) != null){
		CommunityCoreConfig.analytics.digitalData.environment = 'prod';
	}
    window.CoreIntcCommunity.init(CommunityCoreConfig);
	if (DashboardUpdates.length) {
		window.CoreIntcCommunity.updateDashboard(DashboardUpdates);
	}
	if (DashboardCancels.length) {
		window.CoreIntcCommunity.cancelDashboard(DashboardCancels);
	}
}
    
    
function getMeta(metaName) {
	const metas = document.getElementsByTagName('META');
	for (let i = 0; i < metas.length; i++) {
		if (metas[i].getAttribute('name') === metaName) {
			return metas[i].getAttribute('content');
		}
	}
	return '';
}

function insertCoreScript() {
    var scr = document.createElement('script'); 
 	scr.type = 'text/javascript';
    scr.onload = callCommunityCore;
    // scr.src = $A.get('$Resource.Core_INTC') + '/general/coreIntcCommunity.js';
    scr.src = $A.get('$Resource.Core_INTC') + '/general/coreIntcCommunityMin.js';
    console.log('coreIPAlinkresource'+scr.src);
    document.body.appendChild(scr);
}
    
function insertAvaamoBot() {
    var scr = document.createElement('script'); 
 	scr.type = 'text/javascript';
    //scr.onload = callCommunityCore;
    scr.src = $A.get('$Resource.ICS_AVM_ChatBot') +'/ChatBotScript/ChatBotScriptLoad.js';
    console.log('insertAvaamoBot'+scr.src);
    document.body.appendChild(scr);
}
    
    
function setAddressTrackingCookie() {
	var cname = "IPA_URL_Tracking";
	var strHref = window.location.href;

	if(strHref.indexOf("accessdenied") === -1) {
		document.cookie = cname + "=" + strHref + ";path=/";
	}
}


function testForAnalytics(evt) {
	if (window.wap_tms && window.wap_tms.custom && window.wap_tms.custom.salesForceHit) {
		if (AnalyticsHits.length) {
			clearTimeout(TimeoutId);
			AnalyticsHits.forEach(function(hit){
				window.CoreIntcCommunity.callSalesforceHit(hit);
			});
			AnalyticsHits.length = 0;
		}

		if (evt) {
			window.CoreIntcCommunity.callSalesforceHit(evt);   
		}
	} else {
		if (evt) {
			AnalyticsHits.push(evt);   
		}
		if (TimeoutCounter < 30) {
			if (RootAnalyticsLoaded) {
				TimeoutCounter++;
				TimeoutId = setTimeout(function(){
					testForAnalytics();
				}, 1000);  
			}
		} else {
			MaxTimeouts = true;
		}
	}
	if (evt && evt.data && evt.data.analyticsType === 'pageview') {
		setAddressTrackingCookie();
	}
}


window.focus = function(dataName) {
	if (dataName) {
        var windowData;
		switch (dataName) {
			case 'cookie':
				windowData = document.cookie;
				break;
			case 'meta':
				windowData = {
                    pageType: getMeta('pageType') || '',
                    title: getMeta('title') || ''
                };
				break;
			case 'utag':
				windowData = window.utag;
				break;
		}
		return windowData;
	} else {
		WindowFocus();
	}
};


window.addEventListener("message", function(evt) {
    var fullLocation = window.location.protocol + '//' + window.location.hostname + (window.location.port ? ':' + window.location.port : '');
	console.log('fullLocation........'+fullLocation);
    if (evt.origin === fullLocation && evt.data) {
		switch (evt.data.type) {
			case 'intel.analyticsLoaded':
				RootAnalyticsLoaded = true;
				testForAnalytics();
				break;
            case  'intel.cancelDashboard':
				if (CoreScriptLoaded) {
					window.CoreIntcCommunity.cancelDashboard(evt.data.data);
				} else {
					DashboardCancels.push(evt.data.data);
				}
				break;
			case 'intel.loadCommunityCore':
				if (!CoreCommunityLoaded) {
					CoreCommunityLoaded = true;
					insertCoreScript();
                    insertAvaamoBot();
				}
				break;
            case 'intel.renderBreadcrumbs':
				if (CommunityCoreConfig.ighf.breadcrumbs.available) {
					window.CoreIntcCommunity.renderIghfBreadcrumbs(evt.data.data);
				} else {
					CommunityCoreConfig.ighf.breadcrumbs.waitingData = evt.data.data;
				}
				break;
			case  'intel.salesForceHit':
				if (!MaxTimeouts) {
					testForAnalytics(evt);   
				}
				break;
            case  'intel.updateDashboard':
				if (CoreScriptLoaded) {
					window.CoreIntcCommunity.updateDashboard(evt.data.data);
				} else {
					DashboardUpdates.push(evt.data.data);
				}
				break;
		}
	}
}, false);


setAddressTrackingCookie();
  //  insertAvaamoBot();
</script>
